summary: Admin-web (React SPA) bug-fix verification (frontend only). Logged into /api/admin-panel/login as admin@ridepact.com / Admin@12345 -> Sign In to Admin Panel -> redirected to /dashboard with 'Signed in successfully as Administrator' toast. Navigated to /api/admin-panel/destinations: table renders with columns SCHOOL / DESTINATION / CODE / TERMINALS / DIRECTIONS, rows visible (Downtown Transit Center, Main Campus - Student Union, North Campus Housing, TEST_Dest_jezzpw), Directions column consistently shows 'Both (to + from)', Terminals column empty (matches backend contract terminals:[]). NO crash, no white/red screen, no 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading join)' error. Navigated to /api/admin-panel/settings: all sections render (Matching & Group Rules, Automated Push Triggers, Admin Accounts). 'Admin Accounts' lists admin@ridepact.com with 'Super Admin' badge. NO crash, no 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading map)' error. Sanity: Dashboard (98 users, charts, KPIs) and Users pages also render cleanly. Zero JS console errors and zero page/runtime errors captured across all four pages. Both previously-crashing pages are now healthy.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend-only fix confirmed sufficient: /api/admin/destinations now returns terminals:[] and directions, /api/admin/settings now returns adminAccounts derived from admin users. Admin-web renders both fields without needing any client-side defensive fallback change.

Minor UX polish (optional, not a bug): Destinations table headers 'TERMINALS' and 'DIRECTIONS' render but the TERMINALS column body is empty for every row because backend currently returns terminals:[]. If most destinations legitimately have no terminals, consider hiding the column or showing a '-' placeholder to distinguish 'no data' from 'not loaded'.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (5/5 checks passed - login, destinations render, settings render, no console errors, dashboard+users sanity)

seed_data_creation: None. Used existing admin@ridepact.com credentials only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin-web SPA lives at https://typography-74.preview.emergentagent.com/api/admin-panel/ (React Router basename=/api/admin-panel). Login via input[type=email]+input[type=password]+button:has-text('Sign In to Admin Panel'). Post-login lands on /dashboard. Testable pages: /dashboard, /users, /destinations, /settings (all verified healthy this iteration). Bug fix (terminals:[] + adminAccounts in backend DTOs) is confirmed live.
rca_of_issue: Original crashes were reading row.terminals.join(...) on DestinationsPage.jsx:64 and settings.adminAccounts.map(...) on SettingsPage.jsx:246. Backend responses lacked those keys so the values were undefined and .join / .map threw. Backend fix (return terminals:[] on every destination + return adminAccounts derived live from admin users on settings) makes both fields defined arrays, so .join and .map succeed. Verified end-to-end via the served admin-web build - no rebuild was needed.
